contracts.docstring: Native context reads distinguish original page IDs and revisions across same-path local/global pages without automatic vector injection.
Native wiki and its package entry load no framework memory, model stack or retired catalog.
A role name cannot construct a second model/tool owner or inject unversioned framework memory.
Retiring constructors leaves old identities, memory text and recorded execution available without adopting or executing them.
Native capabilities offering claim previews also expose actual review feedback; a historical role no longer selects tools.

scope: New/changed Python definitions and modules in this delivery. Relevant new frontend modules and exported helpers also carry English JSDoc; no claim that all historic project definitions are documented.
